body.message:
- The property is available immediately.
- The short-term monthly rental rate is AED 8,000 per 30 days for a 2-month period.
- Payments can be made on a monthly basis.
- A security deposit of AED 2,000 is required, which is fully refundable upon check-out, provided there are no damages to the apartment. The refund will be processed within 7 working days after your departure.
- The rate is all-inclusive, covering utilities and other standard charges.

We can arrange a viewing for you at your convenience. Your husband may also attend the viewing on your behalf if preferred.

Please let us know how you would like to proceed.
